# Linecaster

> Modular OCR pipelines you can run anywhere: text recognition (OCR and HTR) for print and handwriting, with layout, line, text, table and formula recognizers and post-processing as blocks of datatrove pipelines that run in-process or against model servers, on a laptop, a cluster or Hugging Face Jobs.

Every model configuration is a catalog preset at a pinned revision; tested combinations are recipes. The pages below are Markdown, except the generated Blocks and Catalog, which are the site's pages (llms-full.txt holds their indexes).

## Start

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/storytracer/linecaster/main/README.md): why, quick start, how it works, running anywhere, outputs

## Reference

- [Glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/storytracer/linecaster/main/docs/reference/glossary.md): The terms linecaster uses, one meaning each.
- [Conventions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/storytracer/linecaster/main/docs/reference/conventions.md): Rules that hold across the repository.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/storytracer/linecaster/main/docs/reference/architecture.md): What linecaster is made of and how a run fits together.
- [Pipelines: contracts and the builder](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/storytracer/linecaster/main/docs/reference/pipelines.md): A pipeline is a list of blocks (datatrove `PipelineStep`s) and composites.
- [The data model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/storytracer/linecaster/main/docs/reference/data-model.md): `linecaster.data` holds what a page's text recognition produces; `linecaster.data.page` the page record it travels in.
- [Serialization and working images](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/storytracer/linecaster/main/docs/reference/serialization.md): `linecaster.formats.{alto,pagexml,hocr}` write and read the three XML formats on lxml; `linecaster.images.convert` turns any page image into the working image.
- [The catalog: models, presets, recipes, evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/storytracer/linecaster/main/docs/reference/catalog.md): The catalog describes every model Linecaster can run, how it runs it, the tested combinations, and the measurements behind them.
- [Tracing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/storytracer/linecaster/main/docs/reference/tracing.md): Every run is traced with OpenTelemetry (`linecaster.tracing`).
- [Compatibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/storytracer/linecaster/main/docs/reference/compatibility.md): What linecaster keeps stable for derivatives, pipelines and stored outputs, and how a change that breaks it is announced.
- [Broker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/storytracer/linecaster/main/docs/reference/broker.md): The broker is a shared folder through which workers across tasks, runs and machines agree on who uses which shared resource and what is unavailable until when.

## Generated

- [Blocks](https://storytracer.github.io/linecaster/latest/blocks/): every block by family, with a page each (contract, backends, options, behavior)
- [Catalog](https://storytracer.github.io/linecaster/latest/catalog/): engines, models, presets, pipelines and recipes, with a page each and their evidence
